data.narrative:
Ayar Labs, a Series E AI & Software company founded by Mark Wade and Vladimir Stojanovic, is valued at $3.75B post-money following $870M+ in total funding. The peer universe comprises 9 comparable companies: 1 public (Palantir/PLTR) and 8 private entities including Crusoe Energy, SandboxAQ, Waymo, and Figure AI.

Two valuation methods triangulate the company's fair value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.4x multiplier typical of Series E advancement to the $3.8B last post-money valuation, implying $5.2B. Peer-median methodology examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Palantir at $312.5B, Crusoe Energy at $10.0B, and SandboxAQ at $5.8B, yielding a $10.0B median, though the range ($5.8B–$312.5B) reflects material dispersion driven by Palantir's outlier scale.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $4.5B (low) to $11.5B (high), with a median of $7.6B. The current $3.75B valuation sits materially below this range, suggesting potential upside if company fundamentals align with peer benchmarks. Key uncertainties include the legitimacy of Palantir's comparable status given its exceptional scale and public-market premium, and whether Ayar's proprietary technology and market position warrant positioning at the upper or lower quartile of the peer set. Additional clarity on revenue, growth trajectory, and competitive moat would narrow this band.
